title: Sam Darnold doesn't have much to say about Rams acquiring Myles Garrett

sources.title: Sam Darnold doesn't have much to say about Rams acquiring Myles Garrett
sources.description: The narrow gap between the Seahawks and Rams may have been closed, and then some, with this week's acquisition of defensive end Myles Garrett by L.A.
